newsitem.title: NIGERIA: NIGERIA TO HOST ALL-AFRICA GAMES IN 2003.
newsitem.headline: NIGERIA TO HOST ALL-AFRICA GAMES IN 2003.

text.p: Nigeria said on Tuesday it had been chosen to host the 2003 All-Africa Games.

"The SCSA (Supreme Council for Sports in Africa) recently communicated to us that we have been granted the hosting rights of the African Games in 2003," sports minister Jim Nwobodo told a news conference.
Zimbabwe is to host the seventh edition of the four-yearly Games in 1999.
Nwobodo said "necessary positive measures" would be taken to ensure a successful Games in Nigeria.
"A new multi-purpose stadium will be built in the capital Abuja to supplement the four major stadia in our country...," he said.
